title: Payroll service employee roster and payment register, July 2025 to June 2026
source_system: Payroll service portal
what_it_shows: 7 active employees by role: the Owner, the Center Director, the Director of Tutoring, the Enrollment and Billing Coordinator and 3 Lead Tutors; 14 active contractor tutors paid as independent contractors; payroll and contractor payments run every two weeks; 2 employee separations in the period, the former Enrollment and Billing Coordinator and a temporary front-desk worker, each with a last working day

title: Staff and contractor tutor roster
source_system: Center Director's roster spreadsheet in the shared drive (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: 7 employees and 14 active contractor tutors with start dates, background screening dates and renewal dates, and child-safety training dates, each dated before the person's first session; former contractor tutors marked inactive with their last session date; no column for account set-up or removal; no security or privacy training recorded

title: Tutoring platform user and role export
source_system: Tutoring platform admin console (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: 24 active staff and tutor accounts, each named to one person; the Director of Tutoring and the 3 Lead Tutors hold the administrator role; tutor accounts see only the students assigned to them; parent accounts see only their own children; student accounts are issued by the platform; trial student accounts are a separate account type, and about 35 were created in 2026

title: Tutoring platform security, retention and export settings
source_system: Tutoring platform admin console (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: MFA is available and is not enforced for any role; sign-in is throttled after repeated failures; idle tutor sessions end after 30 minutes; younger children sign in on center tablets with a picture password; the audit log records sign-ins, record views, exports and administrator actions; the retention setting is at the default, which keeps student records and session recordings with no end date; session recordings can be shared by link; the data export history shows no exports

title: Scheduling platform user list and administrator settings
source_system: Scheduling and billing platform admin console (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Named staff accounts; one administrator account, held by the Enrollment and Billing Coordinator, signs in with a password only; the vendor offers MFA for administrator accounts only, and it is off; parents use the parent portal with their own sign-in

title: Productivity suite users, MFA and alert settings
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-03), exported by the MSP
what_it_shows: 7 named staff accounts with MFA enforced through a phone authenticator app; sign-in lockout on vendor defaults; audit logging on; built-in alerts for mass downloads, new forwarding rules and risky sign-ins not configured; no accounts for contractor tutors; accounts are created and disabled by the MSP on the Center Director's request

title: Shared-drive permission report
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: The "Student files" folder is open to all 7 staff accounts, including the 3 Lead Tutors, and is not shared outside the company; it holds intake forms, evaluation reports and IEP or 504 plan excerpts provided by parents for about 260 students, and the district roster spreadsheets, which list all 90 program students; files sync to the company computers through the suite sync client

title: Website builder user list
source_system: Website builder admin console (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: 2 administrator logins: one for the Center Director and one in the name of the former Enrollment and Billing Coordinator

title: MSP device and policy report
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
what_it_shows: 8 managed computers, 7 company laptops (4 staff, 3 Lead Tutors) and 1 front-desk desktop, each with the MSP's remote management agent; the 10 student tablets appear in the MSP's mobile device settings in kiosk mode, with no screen lock and no stored student data; staff have no local administrator rights; laptops lock after 15 minutes idle; the front-desk desktop uses one shared login whose password was last set in 2024 and is excluded from the screen lock policy

title: MSP encryption report
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
what_it_shows: Full-disk encryption on the 7 laptops; not enabled on the front-desk desktop

title: MSP monthly service report, June 2026
source_system: MSP report emailed to the Center Director
what_it_shows: Monthly operating system and application patching of the 8 company computers; firewall firmware updated quarterly; signature antivirus on the 8 computers; the services listed do not include endpoint detection and response or log monitoring

title: Antivirus console export
source_system: MSP antivirus management console
what_it_shows: Signature antivirus active on the 8 computers with automatic definition updates; no behavior-based detection module; alerts go to an MSP mailbox that is checked during business hours; no alert is sent to the company

title: Firewall and Wi-Fi configuration export
source_system: MSP network documentation and firewall management
what_it_shows: The firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic; staff Wi-Fi uses WPA2 with a password last changed in 2023; the staff Wi-Fi and the student and guest Wi-Fi are on the same network segment; firewall logs are kept for 7 days; the MSP keeps a backup of the firewall configuration; one internet line

title: Backup job report and settings, April to June 2026
source_system: SaaS backup console (SYS-06), exported by the MSP
what_it_shows: Nightly copy of suite email and the shared drive; 30 days of versions (the default); immutable retention off; one MSP administrator account with no second factor registered; no restore jobs in the job history

title: MSP ticket history, July 2025 to June 2026
source_system: MSP ticketing system
what_it_shows: Tickets show returned laptops wiped before reuse; the retirement of 2 laptops in 2025 was closed with no wipe or destruction record; account requests are opened from the Center Director's emails; no restore test tickets

title: Tutoring platform student and recording counts
source_system: Tutoring platform reporting (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: About 420 students active in the last 12 months, about 250 of them under 13 by recorded grade (all 90 district program students, in grades 3 to 5, and about 160 private-pay students in grades K-6); records of about 1,900 former students going back to 2019; every online session recording since 2019 is still stored

title: Online enrollment agreement and consent records
source_system: Scheduling and billing platform (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: The online enrollment agreement has a privacy check box; it says the company "may collect information to provide services", lists name, grade and school, and links in its footer to the website privacy notice; it explains that signing and paying the enrollment fee by card completes enrollment; it offers no separate choice about disclosures to third parties; each family account stores the check box date; a copy is emailed to the parent at sign-up

title: Session, billing and payment report, Q2 2026
source_system: Scheduling and billing platform reporting (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: About 300 sessions a week, about 180 in person and about 120 online; about 60 sessions per operating day; about 290 private-pay families billed in the last 12 months, all with Florida billing addresses; monthly autopay invoices on the 1st, about $77,000 a month; about 20 families pay by bank debit and the rest by card through the integrated processor; no payment plans or financing

title: Website privacy notice and inquiry form
source_system: Website builder (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Generic template notice that mixes marketing text with privacy terms and does not mention children's information; it describes website cookies and the inquiry form only and gives the company's email address as the only contact; it lists no third parties, no retention period and no parents' rights; the link is in the website footer only; the inquiry and free-assessment form collects parent contact details

title: Parent request emails, 2026
source_system: Center Director's mailbox (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: 2 parent requests in 2026 to see what information the company holds about their child, both answered by email within a week with a list of scheduling and progress records that left out recordings, messages and work samples; one request came from an email address not on the family account and was answered; no identity check is recorded; requests arrive by email or at the front desk

title: Company card and bank statements, July 2025 to June 2026
source_system: Company credit card and bank statements
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the tutoring platform vendor, the scheduling and billing platform vendor, the productivity suite vendor, the website builder, the MSP (monthly service including the backup), the internet provider, the payroll service, the outside accountant and the cyber insurer; no separate charges from AI tool vendors; card processing fees deducted by the scheduling platform's processor

title: Tutoring platform terms of service
source_system: Tutoring platform vendor website and admin console
what_it_shows: Click-through standard terms accepted online; customer data may be used in de-identified form to improve the vendor's products, including AI features; customer data is deleted within 30 days after the contract ends; a data processing addendum is offered on request, and none is signed; no written security commitments to the customer

title: Scheduling platform vendor terms and documentation
source_system: Scheduling platform vendor website
what_it_shows: Standard terms state daily backups and give no recovery time or recovery point; no SOC 2 report is offered; card numbers are entered in the payment processor's hosted fields and are not stored in the customer account; sign-in locks after repeated failures; MFA is offered for administrator accounts only

title: SaaS vendor security documentation
source_system: Vendor websites (productivity suite, backup vendor through the MSP, website builder)
what_it_shows: The suite and backup vendors describe encryption of stored data and TLS in transit; the suite vendor describes sign-in lockout and audit logging; the website builder hosts the site, the inquiry form and the privacy notice over TLS

title: MSP service contract
source_system: Owner's contracts folder
what_it_shows: Covers help desk, patching of the company computers, antivirus, firewall and Wi-Fi, productivity suite administration and backup administration; help desk response within 4 business hours; no recovery time commitment; no security, incident notice or subcontractor terms; describes the remote management agent installed on every company computer; the backup service is provided through a subcontractor that the contract does not name

title: Contractor tutor agreement template
source_system: Owner's contracts folder
what_it_shows: Covers scope of work, pay, child-safety conduct and background screening; contains no confidentiality, security, device, incident reporting or data deletion terms; the 14 active contractor tutors signed this template

title: School district contract and data privacy agreement
source_system: Owner's contracts folder
what_it_shows: After-school tutoring at 2 elementary schools on Tuesday and Thursday, 3:00 pm to 4:30 pm, for about 90 students; paid from the district's general operating funds, about $180,000 a year; designates the company a school official for the program; the district sends a roster with student names, grade, teacher, reading and math assessment scores and accommodation notes; data used only for the program; no redisclosure; reasonable safeguards; notice to the district within 48 hours of discovering unauthorized access; deletion within 60 days after the contract ends, with certification; district audit right; sessions delivered or made up, attendance reported weekly and progress quarterly; no written statement of the scope of the district's authorization for program students' platform accounts

title: Vendor folder and SOC 2 report request
source_system: Center Director's vendor folder; email to the tutoring platform vendor
what_it_shows: No SOC 2 reports, security questionnaires or written security assurances from any vendor or the MSP are on file; the tutoring platform vendor's SOC 2 report was requested by email on 2026-07-07, the first request on record

title: Cyber liability insurance policy
source_system: Owner's contracts folder
what_it_shows: Cyber liability policy with a 24x7 breach hotline and panel vendors (breach counsel, forensics)

title: Policies folder and document request response
source_system: Document request list; Owner's and Center Director's files
what_it_shows: No written information security program, security policies, risk assessment, incident response plan, contingency or downtime procedures, data retention policy, or inventory of systems and of where children's information is kept was provided; no written designation of a security coordinator was on file; the response included the employee handbook, the child-safety code of conduct and reporting procedure, and the contracts folder

title: Employee handbook and child-safety documents
source_system: Center Director's HR files
what_it_shows: Employee handbook signed by each employee, with a short confidentiality clause; child-safety code of conduct and child-safety reporting procedure for staff and contractor tutors; no rules of behavior for contractor tutors

title: District vendor security questionnaire
source_system: Center Director's mailbox (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: Annual vendor security questionnaire from the district for vendors that handle student data; the questions follow the Trust Services Criteria for security and confidentiality; a self-assessment is accepted from vendors of the company's size; response due 2026-09-30

title: AI progress insights module settings, usage and release note
source_system: Tutoring platform admin console (SYS-01); vendor release note in the Director of Tutoring's mailbox
what_it_shows: The vendor's May 2026 release note announces the module, on by default for all customers; the module is on; first use by the Director of Tutoring on 2026-05-18; about 210 students scored (about 90 district and about 120 private-pay); each flag shows its top two factors; inputs are practice exercise accuracy and time on task, attendance, session counts, grade level and assessment scores, including district scores for program students; the homework helper chatbot is listed and is off

title: FY2025 revenue and cash report
source_system: Outside accountant (bookkeeping system)
what_it_shows: Revenue of about $1.1 million: about $920,000 from families, about $3,700 billed per operating day, and about $180,000 from the district contract; no federal grants, E-Rate discounts or other revenue sources; cash on hand covers about 45 days of expenses

title: Intake interviews
source_system: Interviews (Owner, Center Director, Director of Tutoring, Enrollment and Billing Coordinator)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process and the systems it uses. The Center Director adds and removes staff and contractor tutor accounts when remembered, with no checklist, and asks the MSP by email for suite and device changes; parents' deletion requests are handled by removing the family account in the scheduling platform. The Director of Tutoring emails the district roster spreadsheets to each program contractor tutor at a personal address each term, uses the AI progress flags for district placement and parent progress reports with no written review rule, and states that tutors use public generative AI chatbots to make practice worksheets; how many tutors do so, and what they enter, was not recorded. Asked how a suspected breach would be handled, the interviewees named the MSP; none named the district's 48-hour notice term or a Florida deadline

title: Learning center walk-through and device count
source_system: Learning center (observation)
what_it_shows: 7 laptops, 1 front-desk desktop and 10 student tablets counted; one learning center with a front desk, an office, 6 tutoring rooms and an open study area; firewall and Wi-Fi equipment in a locked network closet; the student and guest Wi-Fi password is posted at the front desk; one internet line

title: Information Security Coordinator designation letter
source_system: Owner's files
what_it_shows: Letter signed by the Owner on 2026-07-13 naming the Center Director as Information Security Coordinator under 16 CFR 312.8(b)(1) and privacy contact for parents

title: Tutoring platform vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: Tutoring platform vendor (sent by email on request)
what_it_shows: Type 2 report with an unqualified opinion for the 12 months ending 2026-04-30, covering security, availability and confidentiality; the system description states an RTO of 8 hours, an RPO of 1 hour, and customer notice within 72 hours of confirming a security incident; encryption at rest and TLS 1.2 or higher, including recordings; one exception (a late quarterly access review of vendor engineers), remediated; complementary user entity controls listed (user provisioning and removal, role assignment, enabling MFA, setting data retention, reviewing customer audit logs); hosting and video streaming providers carved out; the AI progress insights module was released after the period and is not covered; no bridge letter

title: BIA interviews with process owners
source_system: Interviews (Owner, Center Director, Director of Tutoring, Enrollment and Billing Coordinator, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems, vendors and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say the process can tolerate

title: Risk assessment interviews
source_system: Interviews (Owner, Center Director, Director of Tutoring, Enrollment and Billing Coordinator, 2 Lead Tutors, 3 contractor tutors, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' accounts of past events and near misses. Contractor tutors describe teaching online from their own computers and receiving district roster spreadsheets by email at personal addresses. Lead Tutors can see tutor-student messages and review messages and recordings only after a complaint. Recording links are sent to parents with no check of the recipient. The MSP lead technician describes the remote management agent on every company computer; no technician list or evidence of MFA on the remote management platform was supplied

title: Account comparison and clean-up, 2026-07-15 to 2026-07-16
source_system: Staff and contractor roster (EV-002) compared with the tutoring platform and website builder user lists; tutoring platform sign-in log
what_it_shows: 3 former contractor tutors still had active platform accounts 2 to 7 months after their last session; the platform log shows no sign-ins after each tutor's last session; the 3 accounts were disabled on 2026-07-15, leaving 21 active staff and tutor accounts; the former Enrollment and Billing Coordinator's website builder login was removed on 2026-07-16; the scheduling platform user list was not part of the comparison

title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (Owner, Center Director, Director of Tutoring, Enrollment and Billing Coordinator, 3 Lead Tutors, 3 contractor tutors, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each COPPA requirement and district contract term is handled today. The Center Director states that the company uses none of the notice and consent exceptions in 312.4(c)(2)-(4) and 312.5(c)(2)-(9), that nobody reviews logs, and that no evaluation of a security program has taken place; the Owner states that the company belongs to no COPPA safe harbor program; the MSP lead technician states that no restore or contingency test has been run; the 3 contractor tutors state that they use the rosters only for sessions, keep them on their own computers, and have no written rule on their use

title: Center and enrollment flow walk-through, 2026-07-14
source_system: Learning center (observation); online enrollment flow in SYS-02; alarm company records
what_it_shows: The center is locked outside opening hours with an alarm, and the alarm company's records show it armed after closing; keys are held by the Owner, the Center Director and the Director of Tutoring; the office and the network closet are locked; paper intake forms go in a regular recycling bin; the online enrollment flow collects the parent's details, the child's name, age, grade and school, the privacy check box and the enrollment fee payment, and collects nothing directly from the child

title: Copies of the website privacy notice, enrollment agreement and student portal sign-in page, 2026-07-14
source_system: Website (SYS-08); scheduling and billing platform (SYS-02); student portal (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Dated copies saved for P03. The notice text is the same as in EV-019. The enrollment agreement text is the same as in EV-017; it does not mention user names, voice and video in online sessions and recordings, work samples, messages or AI analysis, and names no third parties. The student portal sign-in page and the online classroom have no link to a privacy notice. None of the three texts states a retention period or how parents can review or delete information

title: Trial account and consent record comparison
source_system: Tutoring platform trial account list (SYS-01) compared with consent records and message history in SYS-02
what_it_shows: About 35 trial student accounts created in 2026 for prospective students had no enrollment agreement or check box record in SYS-02 when the account was created; the SYS-02 message history shows no notice or consent request to parents about the AI progress insights module

title: Platform and parent portal walk-through
source_system: Tutoring platform (SYS-01) and the SYS-02 parent portal (observation with the Director of Tutoring)
what_it_shows: Parents see progress reports in the portal; recordings, messages and work samples are not offered to parents; badges and rewards ask for no extra information, and there are no contests; for a family whose scheduling platform account was removed at the parent's request, the platform record, the recordings and the shared-drive files remain

title: Personnel and contractor file sample
source_system: Center Director's HR and contractor files (5 files)
what_it_shows: Background screening and child-safety training completed before the first session in 5 of 5 sampled employee and contractor tutor files

title: MSP evidence for the control assessment, July 2026
source_system: MSP reports and exports (backup console, firewall management, monitoring and antivirus consoles), requested 2026-07-27
what_it_shows: July 2026 backup job report and retention settings; firewall rule and Wi-Fi configuration export; July 2026 monthly patch and antivirus report showing patches applied to the 8 company computers and current definitions; the MSP states that no restore test record exists; the technician list, evidence of MFA on the remote management platform, and the backup subcontractor's name and terms were not supplied

title: Firewall management change verification
source_system: External scan of the center's public internet address; MSP change note
what_it_shows: The MSP turned off internet-side access to the firewall management page on 2026-08-06; a repeat external scan that day found the page no longer reachable

title: AI module outcome and use review
source_system: Tutoring platform flag history and July 2026 assessments (SYS-01); district placement records; June and July 2026 progress reports
what_it_shows: For 120 students with enough data, May and June flags were compared with July platform assessments: 21 of 38 red-flagged students and 9 of 82 unflagged students scored below the grade-level benchmark; 13 of 29 students with accommodation notes and 25 of 91 without were flagged red; among the 90 students at benchmark in July, 7 of 18 with notes and 10 of 72 without had been flagged red; 34 of 36 district placement changes followed the flag with no other reason recorded; 31 progress reports in June and July carried the line "our progress system recommends 3 sessions per week", and 12 of those families then added sessions

title: Control assessment: account management test
source_system: Platform, scheduling platform, suite and website user lists compared with the staff and contractor roster; roster sample of 6; Center Director, Director of Tutoring and MSP interviews
what_it_shows: Account types, approvals, procedures, monitoring and reviews are not documented; accounts are created on verbal request; 4 platform administrators; about 35 trial child accounts were created in 2026 before parental consent; a former temporary front-desk worker's scheduling platform account was still active, last used in May 2026 with no sign-ins after the worker left, and was disabled on 2026-08-04; the front-desk desktop uses one shared login whose password has not changed since 2024; the 6 sampled accounts were issued after a signed agreement and background screening and match each person's role

title: Control assessment: personnel termination review
source_system: Payroll separations; contractor roster; key list; platform user list; Center Director interview
what_it_shows: No time limit for removing access; 3 contractor tutors kept platform access 2 to 7 months after their last session; MFA registrations and the shared front-desk password were not revoked or changed; no exit discussion of confidentiality duties; keys and company laptops collected from both departed employees (key log); departed tutors' session notes stay in the platform under the student record

title: Control assessment: MFA sign-in tests
source_system: Sign-in attempts without a second factor on platform administrator accounts, the scheduling platform administrator, the backup console and the firewall management page, with the MSP present
what_it_shows: Suite administrator accounts required MFA; platform administrator accounts, the scheduling platform administrator, the backup console and the firewall management login accepted a password alone

title: Control assessment: training records and interviews
source_system: Roster training dates; interviews with 4 staff and 3 contractor tutors
what_it_shows: New staff and contractor tutors receive child-safety training only; no security or privacy training at the start, yearly, or after system changes such as the AI module; no phishing simulations or other awareness techniques

title: Control assessment: backup configuration review
source_system: MSP July 2026 backup job report and retention settings; platform SOC 2 report; MSP lead technician interview
what_it_shows: Suite email and shared drive copied nightly; 30 of 31 July jobs succeeded and the failed job was re-run; the MSP backs up the firewall configuration; stored copies are encrypted; versions are not immutable and are kept for 30 days; one MSP administrator account can delete them; the company holds no copy of platform or scheduling data; the vendor folder, contractor agreements and consent records exported from SYS-02 are on paper or only in vendor systems

title: Control assessment: contingency test review
source_system: MSP confirmation; Center Director and MSP lead technician interviews
what_it_shows: No contingency plan exists to test; no restore has ever been tried; the MSP confirmed that no restore test record exists

title: Control assessment: risk assessment review
source_system: P01 risk register and report; draft POL-02; Center Director interview
what_it_shows: First risk assessment completed 2026-07-24 with SP 800-30 tables, including effects on children and families and the BIA impact values; results shared with the Owner and the MSP lead technician; no earlier risk assessment; the annual review and update rules are in draft POL-02 only

title: Control assessment: vendor agreement review
source_system: Platform, scheduling platform and suite terms; MSP contract; platform SOC 2 report; draft P04 responsibility table
what_it_shows: No security or privacy requirements in the platform, scheduling platform, suite or MSP agreements; platform terms allow de-identified data for AI model improvement; no ongoing vendor monitoring; the platform SOC 2 report was first requested in July 2026; customer, MSP and provider responsibilities are set out in the draft P04 table of 2026-07-24

title: Control assessment: contractor tutor computer review
source_system: Interviews with 3 contractor tutors, with their downloads folders shown on screen; contractor agreement; search of the company mailbox for outgoing roster attachments since January 2026
what_it_shows: No terms for contractor tutors' use of their own computers to reach company systems or to process or store student information; downloading student records is not prohibited; 2 of the 3 contractor tutors had district roster spreadsheets in their downloads folders and deleted them on screen; no files were copied

title: Control assessment: external personnel security review
source_system: Contractor agreement; MSP contract; contractor roster sample of 6; Center Director interview
what_it_shows: Security roles and duties for contractor tutors and the MSP are not set; contractor tutors are not required to follow company security policies; only screening and child-safety requirements are documented; the MSP is not required to report technician departures; screening renewals are tracked on the roster and were current for the 6 sampled

title: Control assessment: retention review
source_system: Platform record counts and retention settings; Center Director interview
what_it_shows: No rules for managing or retaining children's information or system outputs; records of about 1,900 former students and all recordings since 2019 retained; roster spreadsheets and exported reports kept on staff and contractor computers and in email with no end date

title: Control assessment: boundary protection tests
source_system: Firewall rule export; external scan of the center's public internet address; test laptop on the student and guest Wi-Fi
what_it_shows: Unsolicited inbound traffic is blocked; the external scan found the firewall management page reachable from the internet with a password only and no other open service ports; a test laptop on the guest Wi-Fi reached a staff laptop's file-sharing prompt; firewall logs are kept for 7 days and are not reviewed; no monitoring between the Wi-Fi networks

title: Control assessment: incident reporting interviews
source_system: Draft POL-03; interviews with 4 staff and 3 contractor tutors
what_it_shows: 5 of the 7 people interviewed did not know whom to tell about a suspected incident; no reporting requirement or time limit existed outside draft POL-03; nobody knew the district's 48-hour notice term or the Florida deadlines
